description: One Indiana opinion cluster by CourtListener cluster id. Includes opinion text only when the collection has a body; attribution names its source. Includes author when that index is loaded: the slip byline, not the trial judge and not a holding. version_signal is a caution (yellow / red / year banner), never a green certified mark. When paragraph links are loaded, paragraphs says whether this opinion has them (only opinions whose court-printed paragraph numbers run unbroken from 1). paragraph (optional: a number such as 12, or a range such as "12-14", at most 10) returns just those numbered paragraphs, each with its number and its start and end offsets in the full text, cited as ¶ 12. When reporter pages are loaded, reporter_pages gives the reporter, volume and first and last page for opinions whose printed page breaks are on file (older opinions through N.E.3d volume 130; unofficial; verify against the reporter). page (optional: a reporter page such as 512, or a range such as "512-514", at most 5) returns just the text of those printed pages, each with its start and end offsets in the full text. Ask for paragraph or page, not both.
name: case_get
title: Get an Indiana case cluster
